card.name: "With" in DRESS syndrome name
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "drug rash" or "drug reaction", just before "eosinophilia and systemic symptoms". Also a comma after a drug name in severe-reaction instructions.

modes.label: DRESS name
modes.description: "with" joining drug rash or drug reaction to eosinophilia and systemic symptoms.

modes.label: Comma after drug name
modes.description: A comma following a drug name in a discontinue-on-reaction instruction.
modes.example: If severe skin reactions occur, discontinue doxycycline for injection<<,>> USP immediately and institute appropriate therapy.
